tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rtog med don dam rdo rje'i glu zhes bya ba nges don phyag rgya chen po bzhugs so//

rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// yongs dkyil 'khor rigs rnams kun gyi gtso// dus snyigs ma'i sems can 'dul slad du// khyod dge ba'i bshes kyi tshul bzung ba// mtshan bi da ra ṇa sampanna// mi bdag gi gus pas lan du mar// gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs bgyid na// khyod thugs rje'i zer gyis nyer bskyangs nas// don gnas lugs kyi rang ngo sprad du gsol// dpal rdo rje gur gyi rtogs pa las| |rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces sogs yang yang gsungs pa dang*// chos phar phyin theg pa'i sde snod las// sems ni sems nyid ma mchis te// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal du// gsungs pa tshig tu go sla yang*// 'di don du rtogs pa 'ga' ma mchis// rtog ge thal phyir gyi spyod yul du// 'di dpe don tha snyad kyi rig pa dag /mtshan nyid gsum dang lung rigs kyi// don rnam grangs du mas gzhal na yang*// dmus long la kha dog dris pa bzhin// de go yul tsam las snying po med// don gnas lugs rang ngo ma 'phrod par// sgom chen phal cher khrid 'debs kyang*// byis pa la zla ba bstan pa ltar// de rgyang ltas kyi mdzub mos bstan tsam las// don rtsa ba chod pa ma mchis pas// yin rlom gyi ngang du mi tshe 'dzad// rje rdo rje 'chang nas til nag dang*// mar mi dwags po phag gru nas// rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i bar// gshis rang bzhin rnam dag gi bzhugs tshul ni// dpe skyu ru'i 'bras bu lag mthil bzhin// don bsal bzhag med pa mngon sum gzigs// don de las brgyud de mi kho bo'i| |mtshan ldan bla ma bka' drin can// rtogs pa don gyi bla ma'i bar// mi bar khyi yis ma chod cing*// dam nyams dang 'dres khyer gyis ma zin pa'i// brgyud pa mu tig gi phreng ba ltar| |rtsar du byung ba gdams pa'i dpyid// 'khrul med kyi bzhed pa 'di ltar gsungs// chos phyag rgya chen po nyams blangs pas// 'bras bu tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub// bde gshegs rnams kyis gang gsungs pa'i// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong yang*// don 'di las gzhan pa rdul tsam med// 'di gang zag gang gis nyams len tshe// slob dpon nyams myong ldan pa yis// gnad du bsnun nas 'khrid par gces// sems ma bcos rang lugs su bzhag pa na// rnam rtog phra rags kun rang sar zhi// sems rang lugs su gnas pa lhan ne ba// ming zhi gnas su btags so mkhyen par mdzod// sems ma bcos gsal rjen ngos bzung bral// gsal la ma 'gags dwangs sing nge// myong rgyu med pa'i myong ba can// ming lhag mthong zhes pa btags so lo// don zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dbye rgyu med// rang rig rang gsal kyi lhag mthong la// de rang lugs su gnas shing rnam rtog gi// mtshan mas ma gos zhi gnas nyid// don de la zhi lhag zung 'brel zer// 'di sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa yin// 'di sems can rnams kyi sems nyid yin// don chos sku gshis babs kyi gnas lugs yin// sems gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa 'di// ming phyag rgya chen po zhes su btags// bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag rnams// ming tshig dang yi ge grangs mang yang*// don 'di las gzhan yod ma yin no// 'gyu dran kun sangs pa ma yin pa// 'gyu dran sgom du ma bzhag pa// 'gyu dran nyid gsal stong zung du 'jug

/sems nyid phyag rgya chen po la// 'gyu dran gyi rba rlabs 'phyo ba yang*// rgya mtsho dang rba rlabs ngo bo gcig /sems de dang rnam rtog tha dad med// de rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa yin// tshogs drug gi yul snang 'di ka rnams// tshor ba 'gags pa ma yin la// tshor ba gsal stong du sgom pa min// tshor ba'i ngo bo gsal la stong*// tshogs drug snang ba phyi ru med// sems gsal stong mtha' bral nang du med// sems de las der snang tshor bar snang*// rmi lam gyi yul dang rmi lam gyi// shes pa la tha dad med pa bzhin// shar grol 'dzin med kyi rang grol 'di// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa yin// don de ltar bsgoms pa'i rjes 'jug la// nor sa dang sgom skyon 'di 'dra yod// sems gnas cha gtso bor 'dzin pa la// tshogs drug rnams 'gags sam bkag pa'i sems// mtsho la dar chags ji lta ba'i// 'di yin med pa'i gnas pa de// rje sa paṇa gyis bzhed pa'i go 'phang gsum// thob byed kyi zhi gnas skyon can yin// tshogs drug gi snang ba ma 'gags kyang*// de mi gsal ba yi wal wal po// sgom ldem po zhes pa'i skyon can yin// tshogs drug gsal dang mi gsal ba'i// tshor ba med pa'i thom me ba// lung ma bstan zhes skyon can yin// rnam rtog snga ma 'gags pa'i rjes// phyi ma ma skyes pa yi gong*// sems gtad med had po de sgom pa// lhag mthong gis ma zin skyon can yin// yang de dag lhag mthong gis zin na yang*// phyag chen de las ma g.yos pas// had po sgom du 'dod pa'i phyir// de sgom gyi mu ge skyon can yin| |sems bde lhan ne ba tsam sgom pa yang*// lhag mthong gi ye shes med pa'i phyir// rnam rtog dang snang ba dgra ru 'dzin// de gcig la gnyis 'dzin gyi skyon can yin// sems dus gsum gyi rtog pa yod do cog /yid la mi byed stong sang nge*// de yang lhag mthong gi rtsis ma zin// snang cha bkag pa'i skyon can yin// yang gang snang ci shar thams cad la// bden med kyi 'dzin stangs bcas bsgom na// drang nges kyis dred pa'i nges shes can// dngos med du 'dzin pa'i skyon can yin// yang dran med snang ba tshogs drug la// dgag sgrub mi bya sgom zhes pa'ang*// btang snyoms su gnas pa'i skyon can yin// yang sems nyid gsal la mi rtog pa// de dag sgom du 'dzin pa yang*// rtog pa rang sor zhi nas kyang*// rig pa gsal la ngos bzung med// de gnas lugs kyi don dang cha 'dra yang*// mi rtog pa nan gyis 'dod pa'i phyir// de yang don dam phyogs re ba// sems dang sems byung ji snyed pa// gsal stong gi ngang du hrig ge ba// de nyid sgom dang phyogs 'dra yang*// dran pa rlabs chen gyi rang babs dang*// lhug pa'i lhod cha de la med// ha cang bsgrims pa'i sdug btsir can// des kyang gnas lugs rtogs par dka'// 'khor 'das kun stong pa'i rbad kham gyis// skyabs mchog gsum la skyabs su mi 'dzin cing*// dma' 'gro drug la snying rje mi bskyed par// rgyu 'bras la 'jol nyog spyod pa yang*// nag po kha 'byams kyi stong nyid yin// sems gnas sam 'gyu ba'am gang ltar yang*// skyon yon dang gegs sel bogs 'don sogs// dgos 'gag gi snying po dor byas nas// de de ka'i mu la skyongs shig lo// rgyus med kyis rgyus med 'khrid pa la// ming phyag rgya chen por btags pa mang*// sems dngos po'i don dam rtogs so lo// nyon mongs kyi rtog pa skyes ma thag

/rnam rtog kha yan gyi dug lnga rags// sman dug tu song bas gsor ma btub// skyon thams cad kyi rtsa ba zhig de na gda'// sems tha mal gyi shes pa skad pa de// sems rang babs kyi gshis lugs ci snang ba// de spang blang dgag sgrub bcas bcos dang*// rang bzo rtog btags kyis ma bslad par// sems rang babs rang gshis rang mdangs de// sgrim lhod ma dgos rang rig gi// rang sems la yeng med skyong ba de// ming phyag rgya chen por btags pa yin// 'di sgom lugs rnam pa mang byas shing*// ri khrod dang nags khrod dben pa ru// dka' thub dang lus gnad tshogs gsog la// 'bad 'bung bye ba khri byas kyang*// sems yengs ma lam du btang ba yi| |blos byas kyi sgom la snying po med// grong yul dang srang mdo mang po'i dbus// spyod pa bzang ngan ji ltar yang*// sems dran rtog la bzo bcos ma byas par// gang shar 'dzin med du rang babs skyong*// de 'khor ba'i 'dam las ma bsgral na// rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pas bslus// dal khom dang bstun pa'i chos byed rnams// lus drang po lag pa mnyam bzhag sogs| |thun grangs su bcad nas sgom mo lo// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du// dge sbyor gar song cha med thal// sems bcos pa ma zad kun kyang bcos// bcos mas bcos ma bsgom pa dang*// res yod res med kyi sgom pa po// gzan gos gyon phud ji lta ba'i// gnas lugs de 'dras don mthong na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'khrul// bzang ngan gyi 'gyu dran bya byed sogs// gang shar gang snang gi dngos po kun// re dogs der 'dzin med pa'i ngang*// dgag sgrub mi bya ma yeng na// thams cad sgom las 'da' ba med| |yengs na hrig hrig tsog tsog po// sgom du ma song ngal ba'i rgyu// rnal 'byor rnams la shor sa bzhi// shes bya'i gshis dang rgyas 'debs dang*// gnyen po dang ni lam du shor| |de yang gcig dang du bral dang*// phyi rol phra rags rdul phran dang*// nang du skad cig ma la sogs// brtags pa'i stong pa blos dpyad pa// phar phyin theg pa'i gshis shor yin| |gzung 'dzin gdod nas stong pa la// sngags dang tshig gi sbyor ba yis// stong pa nyid du gyur cig lo// yul dang yul can so so ba// rdo rje theg pa'i gshis shor yin// sbyin sogs pha rol phyin drug po// dngos por rlom pa'i 'khrul gzhi la// 'khor gsum dngos por bzung bzung nas// de la dngos med kyis rgyas gdab pa// 'di bka' gdams rnams kyi nyams len te// don rgyas 'debs su shor ba'i skyon can yin// nyon mongs sogs rnam rtog skyes ma thag

/de rang bzhin rnam dag tu ma go bar// spang byar bzung ste blos byas kyi// gnyen po dran rtsis zin no lo// spang bya rtsa ba'i nyon mongs steng*// gnyen po rnam rtog gi kha bsnon brgyab// grang ba'i nad la ga pur bzhin// sgom gnyen por shor ba gsor mi rung*// da lta stong pa nyid bsgoms pas// gzod nas 'bras bu chos kyi sku// thob tu re bas lam du shor// de ltar shor sa bzhi po yang*// sgom chen phal gyi lam du snang*| |dpal phag mo gru pa nyid la yang*// zug rngu kun bde bar shar ba la// sa kun dga' snying pos sa dang po'i// bden pa mthong bar ngo sprad pa// slar mnyam med dwags po'i zhabs drung du// phyin tshe nyams de sprin bzhin dwangs// bla ma'i gsung gis dbugs dbyung mdzad// don des na bde ba'i nyams kyis kyang*// 'dod khams su gol ba nyid du gsungs// bde ba'i bye brag so so bas// ngan song gsum du skye yang srid// sgom gsal dwangs nam mkha' lta bu ni// lkog gyur rnams kyang mngon sum du/ */mthong ba'i nyams kyi 'od gsal des/ */ gzugs kyi khams su gol ba de// deng sang sgom chen phal zhig gis// 'od gsal dang mngon shes kyang de nyid de// lhas byin kyi mngon shes 'di kho na// 'di zag bcas kyi mngon shes ting 'dzin yin// sems dang sems byung yul yul can// 'gyu dran med pa'i stong sang nge// rdul bral chos skur 'dod pa de// gzugs med khams su gol ba ste// rje mi la'i drung du sgam po pas// sems gnas pa'i lo rgyus zhus pa'i tshe// don de las zan cig dga' bar gsungs// tshul des na nyams kyi sgom chen rnams// nyams 'dus byas byas pa'i chos yin phyir| |de mi rtag 'jig par ma gsungs sam// sgom phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa la// sgom pa'i dus su mer re ba// bzhag par lteng po zhes su grags// rnam rtog kha yan du 'gro ba rnams| |btang sar 'khyams pa zhes su grags// lteng dang 'khyam sogs gegs dag gis// dge sbyor la gong 'phel ma byung na// bogs 'don du go cha rnam gnyis bgo// phyi lta ba'i go cha zhes pa yang*// thos bsam gyi go ba blo yul du// yin rlom gyi rig pa thal phyir dang*// rang stong gzhan stong la sogs pa// lung rig dpe ltas kyi kha bshad rnams// don go yul du lus pas gtan mi phebs// don yang dag gi lta ba rtogs par ldan// de rnal 'byor 'bad rtsol can gyis rtogs// nyams myong bar 'brel ba'i gnas lugs de// ma skyes skye med du sing nge ba// mi gnas gnas med kyi hrig ge ba// ma 'gags 'gag med kyi rjen ne ba// ma grub grub med kyi stong nge ba// sku gsum rang chas kyi nyams len 'di// lta ba dang rtogs pa ldan pa yin// nang shes rab kyi go cha zhes pa yang*// gnas dus phun sum tshogs pa la// bla ma'i man ngag ji bzhin du// sgom rim ltar nyams su blangs pa yin// gzhan lhan cig skyes sbyor skyon bzhi ma// de la sogs lung gzhan ma grags kyang*// 'gran zla bral gyi brgyud pa 'di nyid la// go cha gnyis ma mchog tu bzhed// gzhan yang sgom gyi nyams len tshe// zhen log sgom gyi rkang pa yin// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa dang*// tshe mi rtag 'dus byas snying po med// 'jig rten gyi 'khri ba rtsad nas chod| |tshe sgrub pa mnyam pa'i snying phur 'debs// mos gus sgom gyi mgo bo ste// bla ma dang bka' brgyud mchog gsum la// sangs rgyas lta bu'i 'du shes kyis// mos gus gdung bas gsol ba thob// dran pa sgom gyi bya ra yin// dus rgyun chad med par yeng med skyongs// snying rje sgom gyi phrin las te// chos dang gang zag dmigs med pa'i// snying po byang sems rtag tu sgoms// rang sgom nyams mtha' ru ma phyin par// sems ngo mthong tsam gyi lo 'dod kyis// gzhan rjes 'dzin bdud kyi las yin spongs// rje 'jig rten mgon po'i gsung gis kyang*| |ro gcig gi rtogs pa ma skyes par// chos ston pa mi phung bdag brlag yin// don de ltar gsungs pas dben pa bsten// khrel dang ngo tsha bag yod pa// sgom gyi go cha yin pa'i phyir// bag med kyi tho co rmang nas spongs// sgom sna zin tsam nas rtse gcig bar// tshad ldan gyi nyams bzhes med na yang*// yeng med dran pa rgyun chags bya// rtogs pa mnyam rjes ma 'dres bar// mnyam bzhag la yeng med skyong ba dang*// thun mtshams sogs rjes thob lam 'khyer bya// so ma dang rang thang lhug pa gsum// nam mkha' sa gzhi ri bo dang*// mar me man shel ji bzhin du// gu yangs khyab che g.yo 'gul med// gsal la dwangs shing spros pa skyungs// mnyam bzhag tu ngo bo rtse gcig skyongs// rjes thob tu rtog snang dran pas skyongs// snang nyams dang shes nyams la sogs pa// gnas lugs la sgrib phyir de dang phral// sems so ma rjen pa gang shar skyongs// zhi gnas kyi nyams la gtad so med// dbyar ka'i na bun skyes nas 'jig

/lhag mthong gi nyams kyang sprin lta bu// zhen med du bskyangs pas rang sar grol// rtogs pa'i rang nyams 'di 'dzin med du// bskyangs pas yon tan skye bar nges// nyams bying can phal cher gegs su 'gyur// gnas lugs kyi don la sgrib pa'i phyir// thabs sna tshogs kyis bshig nas bsgom pa mchog /de ltar 'dzin med du bskyangs bskyangs nas// bogs 'don la zla'i rim pa bya// rnam rtog dang nyon mongs lha dang 'dre// sdug bsngal dang na tsha 'chi ba sogs// spang blang mi dgos lam du khyer// rtsal sbyong dang bogs 'don gyi mchog tu 'gyur// don gnas lugs rags pa de tsam la// zhib cha bla ma'i man ngag dang*// gdams pa'i bcud kyis rab brgyan te// 'bad rtsol can gyis nyams blangs pas// nyams rtogs kyi skye tshul rnal 'byor bzhi// ngo bo bde la rnam pa gsal// mi rtog pa yi ting nge 'dzin// 'di skyon med ting 'dzin gsum las 'das// 'jig rten chos la zhen pa log /nyams chu bo rba rlabs 'dra ba 'byung*// res 'ga' mtho la res 'ga' dma'// sems kyi rang bzhin ji lta ba// gsal bar yod kyang spros bral gyi// rtogs pas ma nges pa yi phyir// snang la ma nges kyi rtogs pa zer// 'di dus bla ma la gsol 'debs dang*// dben pa bsten nas sgom pa gces// don de la rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor zer// spros dang bral bas mtha' gnyis spangs// shes rab mig gis skye 'gag gnyis// med pa'i chos sku rtogs pa ste// blang dor dang bral ba'i nges shes skyes// dbul pos gter rnyed ji bzhin du// 'khor 'das gnyis la re dogs med// sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba ste// don dam spros bral gyi mngon rtogs kyis// gzung 'dzin ming tshig gi tha snyad kyi// 'khrul ba rnams ni 'di na bsal// gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa 'di skyes na// chu bo gzhol phyogs su 'bab pa bzhin// rnal 'byor phyi ma phyi ma gnyis// babs kyis skye ba rang gshis yin// lar dkar po chig thub bya ba yin/

/chig thub gnyis gsum la sogs pa// rtog ge can gyi rta pho la// 'gong pos bzhon pa'i rgol ngan yang*// gnas 'di rtogs na rmeg med sangs// don de la spros bral kyi rnal 'byor zer// rje snyi sgom chen po'i bzhed pa yin// tshogs drug gi snang cha ji snyed pa// rgya mtsho rba rlabs zhi ba ltar// rang gi sems su lhag gis go// gzung 'dzin kyi rtsa ba rbad kyis chod// gnyis 'dzin gyi mdud pa rang sar grol// 'khor ba dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// sems phyag rgya chen por 'dres pa ste// don de la ro gcig gi rtogs pa zer// yang dben pa bsten cing bla ma la// mos gus kyis gsol btab dge sbyor bya// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis med cing*// mnyam rjes rgyun 'chad med pa ru| |rang sems sangs rgyas su lhag gis go// snang ba'i der 'dzin rtsad nas zhi// yon tan gyi tshogs rnams ngang gis 'byung*// lhun grub kyi rang so rtsir gyis zin// rtog pa'i rba rlabs zhi ba ste// skye 'chi gnyis po ming du byas// ro mnyam chen po'i ngang la gnas// lar gnas skabs kyi sgom med drang ba'i don// blos byas kyi 'jog sgom spangs tsam la'ang*// ming sgom med du sgrub brgyud gong mas bzhed// mthar thug nges don gyi sgom med de// bsgom bya sgom byed mnyam rjes bral// lhun grub sangs rgyas sa mchog yin// des don gnyis 'grub pa gshis babs yin// de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi nyid la// re re'ang gsum gsum dbye ba sogs// don zhib mor bshad pa gzhan du ltos// skyes pa skyong ba'i man ngag ni// smra bcad bya zhing lo 'dod skyung*// bla mar mos gus drag tu skyed// dben pa bsten cing nyams len skyong*// 'khor ba'i chos la snying rje bskyed// byang chub sems gnyis 'bral med 'chang*| |chos bshad pa bas kyang sgrub pa gces// sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i tshe// chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la// yeng med dran pa'i nyams len dang*// skye 'chi sdug bsngal gyi chu bo la| |rtogs pa brtan po'i gdams ngag gces// de ltar bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu yang*// sa lam dang bsgrigs na 'di lta ste// byin rlabs kyi lam la zhugs pa nas// rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i bar// las dang po tshogs lam zhes su bzhed// spros bral dus ni mos spyod pa// sbyor lam ngo bo nyid do zhes// ro gcig dang sgom med chung 'bring ni// sa dang po mthong lam gyi ye shes dang*// sa gnyis pa nas ni bcu pa'i bar// sgom lam zhes su btags pa yin// don dam sgom med chen po ni// mthar phyin lam ste sangs rgyas nyid// 'di mtshan nyid theg pa'i sa lam dang*// lung rig gi sgrig tshom dka' na yang*// don 'khrul ba med do tshad mar zung*// don de ltar phyi rabs rjes 'jug rnams// chos phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la// sgom skyon dang shor gol la sogs pa// nor ba'i 'phrang rnams ngos bzung ste// 'khrul med kyi lam du 'jug pa'i phyir// rtog med don dam rdo rje'i glu| |tshig nyung don tshang gi nges don 'di// chos 'khor 'das sems su thag chod pa// zog po chos kyi grags pa ngas// gnas lugs rnams gsal por smras pa 'di// pha rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dbus gtsos pa'i// rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchod par mdzod// rang dang skal mnyam 'ga' 'ga' la// sems gegs sel bogs 'don gyi pha 'bab mdzod// rtog ge tha snyad mkhan rnams kyi// rlung srog rtsar 'chor ba'i dbyen po mdzod// dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog/
